rows.note: Use 聲明 as the all-purpose noun for a formal statement or assertion.

example.english: This declaration makes it clear that the company will not raise prices.
example.traditional: 呢份聲明講明公司唔會加價。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 sing1 ming4 gong2 ming4 gung1 si1 m4 wui5 gaa1 gaa3

rows.note: Use 宣言 for a public proclamation, manifesto, or especially emphatic declaration rather than an ordinary formal statement.

example.english: The organization issued a declaration that it would continue the struggle.
example.traditional: 個組織發表宣言，宣布會一直抗爭。
example.jyutping: go3 zou2 zik1 faat3 biu2 syun1 jin4 syun1 bou3 wui5 jat1 zik6 kong3 zang1

rows.note: Use 報關單 specifically for a customs declaration form listing goods.

example.english: I have filled out the customs declaration, so I can queue up now.
example.traditional: 我填好咗報關單，依家可以去排隊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tin4 hou2 zo2 bou3 gwaan1 daan1 ji1 gaa1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 paai4 deoi6

rows.note: Use 申報表 for a declaration form used for general administrative or legal reporting rather than specifically customs.

example.english: Remember to submit the declaration form before you can get your ID back.
example.traditional: 記得交埋申報表先可以攞返張證件。
example.jyutping: gei3 dak1 gaau1 maai4 san1 bou3 biu2 sin1 ho2 ji5 lo2 faan1 zoeng1 zing3 gin6
